subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs after the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected, and should turnkey hardware references stay out of the page?
rationale: The patch is a docs-only implementation candidate, but the linked issue explicitly asks for a first-party hardware-docs boundary decision that cannot be settled by CI or source inspection alone.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Repair the JetPack/Ubuntu/flashing guidance, keep the page free of commercial hardware promotion, and treat Jetson like the existing Raspberry Pi install guide.

options.title: Keep Jetson Guidance Outside Core Docs
options.body: Close or pause this PR and direct Jetson-specific setup guidance to vendor or ecosystem documentation instead of first-party OpenClaw docs.

options.title: Ask For Narrower Maintainer Draft
options.body: Have a maintainer sponsor a shorter hardware-agnostic ARM/edge install page before accepting device-specific Jetson guidance.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Repair the JetPack/Ubuntu/flashing guidance, keep the page free of commercial hardware promotion, and treat Jetson like the existing Raspberry Pi install guide.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision hinges on VISION/docs scope and ClawHub boundary guidance where this person has the clearest recent history.
